content_html_sanitized:
It was only recently that I discovered that CBD, cannabidiol, and I were “discovered” the same year, 1940.  I was discovered in a maternity ward in Fort Worth Texas, Texas.


Cannabidiol was discovered in 1940 by Roger Adams and his team at the University of Illinois, from a sample of the hemp plant.

At first, I was amused by the coincidence, but then I thought about all the suffering that might have been prevented if scientists had been encouraged rather than discouraged from exploring its uses.

While Adams isolated CBD, it wasn't until the 1960s and 70s that its properties and potential benefits were further investigated by scientists like Raphael Mechoulam, who also synthesized it in 1963.

A few years after that, I also discovered the cannabinoids in their Mexican manifestations. But how much sooner might they have available to help disabled veterans, for example.

From 2020 See Trump’s Ban On CBD for the Military Echoes Drug War, Anti-Hemp Oil Hysteria

The Wall Street Journal Carries Excellent Story About The Outrageous Medical Abuse of Veterans: But No Mention of Medical Cannabis

 

Younger readers may have a hard time believing how hard the Drug Warriors tried to stop any use of hemp.

And Victory for Hemp Shows Prohibitionist Have Problems With Mandatory Stupidity. The Prohibitionist Dilemma Is That They Are Addicted to Bad Arguments.


In their preening self righteousness the Prohibitionists have even persecuted the parents of children with epilepsy.

See 

Two Stories, Twenty Eight Years: Apart Tell Us Something Terrible About The Medical System

And they want to talk about “saving the children”, and pretend that they are only interested in THC/Marijuana, but that is not what their criminal record shows.
